category_title: Low-confidence students requiring constant teacher validation and one-to-one support
student_description: Esther is a student with limited schooling experience who lacks confidence in her mathematical abilities and relies heavily on constant teacher validation. She uniquely requires a gentle, low-pressure environment and explicit 1:1 guidance that simultaneously connects simple concrete representations to abstract mathematical notation.

criteria.rationale: Esther works slowly and carefully to make sense of math; time pressure causes her to freeze or panic.
criteria.check: The tutor's long-term approach explicitly allows Esther to work at her own pace to make sense of actions, avoiding strict time limits or rushing.

criteria.rationale: Esther is sensitive and prone to panic, requiring a quiet and relaxing environment to feel safe enough to learn.
criteria.check: The tutor's communication strategy emphasizes a gentle, calm, and patient tone, explicitly avoiding loud speech, frustration, or high-pressure demands.
